blocks.text: Asosiy farq qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 85–86-darslar): **sifat** ot haqida gapiradi — a **careful** driver (qanday haydovchi?), **ravish** esa harakat qanday bajarilishini aytadi — he drives **carefully** (qanday qilib haydaydi?). O'zbek tilida ko'pincha bitta so'z ikkala vazifani bajaradi: «**tez** mashina» — «**tez** yuradi», «**yaxshi** odam» — «**yaxshi** gapiradi». Shuning uchun o'zbeklar ko'pincha «He drives careful», «She speaks English good» deyishadi. Inglizchada ravish odatda sifatga **-ly** qo'shib yasaladi va bu farqni albatta saqlash kerak.

Ko'p hollarda sifatga shunchaki `-ly` qo'shiladi: slow → slow**ly**, complete → complete**ly**, safe → safe**ly** (oxirdagi `-e` saqlanadi). Lekin bir nechta imlo qoidasi bor — ular yozma ishlarda tez-tez xatoga sabab bo'ladi.

items.text: The lift stops **automatically** if someone is standing in the doorway.
items.translation: Eshik oldida kimdir tursa, lift **avtomatik ravishda** to'xtaydi.

items.text: Could you **possibly** lend me your car for the weekend?
items.translation: Dam olish kunlariga mashinangizni **mabodo** berib turolmaysizmi?

blocks.text: Ravish + sifat: terribly sorry, reasonably cheap

Ravish faqat fe'lni emas, **sifatni** ham aniqlashi mumkin — bunda u sifatning **darajasini** ko'rsatadi: **reasonably** cheap (nisbatan arzon), **terribly** sorry (juda afsusdaman), **unusually** warm, **completely** different, **absolutely** right, **seriously** ill. Bu yerda ham sifat emas, ravish kerak: «terrible sorry», «reasonable cheap» — xato. Xuddi shunday ravish **fe'lning uchinchi shakli** (V3) bilan ham keladi: **badly** damaged, **seriously** injured, **fully** booked, **poorly** organised, **newly** built, **highly** recommended.

items.text: The film was **surprisingly good**, considering the reviews.
items.translation: Taqrizlarni hisobga olsak, film **kutilmaganda yaxshi** chiqdi.

items.text: Our hotel was **conveniently located** next to the metro.
items.translation: Mehmonxonamiz metro yonida, **qulay joyda joylashgan** edi.

items.text: Her brother is **painfully shy** and rarely says a word at parties.
items.translation: Akasi **o'ta uyatchan**, ziyofatlarda kamdan-kam og'iz ochadi.

blocks.text: **be, look, feel, sound, seem, taste, smell, get, become** — holat fe'llari, ulardan keyin **sifat** keladi (→ 99-dars): You **look happy**. Boshqa fe'llar harakatni bildiradi va ularga **ravish** kerak. Ba'zi fe'llar ikkala ma'noda ishlatiladi — shuning uchun avval fe'l nimani bildirayotganini aniqlang: She **looked sad** (xafa ko'rinardi) — She **looked** at the photo **sadly** (suratga xafa qaradi). Ravish butun gapga baho ham berishi mumkin: **Luckily**, nobody was hurt; **Surprisingly**, the shop was empty.

items.text: The soup **smells delicious**, but it's still too hot to eat.
items.translation: Sho'rvaning **hidi juda yoqimli**, lekin hali yeyishga juda issiq.

items.text: The cat **smelled** the food **cautiously** before eating it.
items.translation: Mushuk ovqatni yeyishdan oldin uni **ehtiyotkorlik bilan hidlab ko'rdi**.

items.text: **Fortunately**, the train was only five minutes late.

blocks.text: -ly bilan tugaydigan sifatlar: friendly, lovely, lonely

Ba'zi so'zlar `-ly` bilan tugasa ham, **sifat**: friendly, lovely, lonely, lively, elderly, silly, ugly, likely, costly, cowardly. Ulardan ravish yasalmaydi («friendlily» yo'q). Harakatni shu ma'noda tasvirlash uchun **in a ... way / manner** ishlatiladi: She smiled at me **in a friendly way**. **daily, weekly, monthly, early** esa ham sifat, ham ravish: a **daily** newspaper — it comes out **daily**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He drives very careful» → **carefully**; «She speaks English very good» → very **well** (→ 101-dars); «I'm terrible sorry» → **terribly** sorry; «The flat is reasonable cheap» → **reasonably** cheap; «The house was bad damaged» → **badly** damaged; «She spoke to me friendly» → **in a friendly way**; teskari xato: «You look beautifully» → You look **beautiful**.

O'zingizga savol bering: **kim / nima qanday?** — javob sifat (a **slow** train, The train is **slow**). **Harakat qanday bajarildi?** yoki **qanchalik?** (boshqa sifatdan oldin) — javob ravish (The train moved **slowly**, **incredibly** slow).

examples.title: Adjective or adverb? a **careful** driver / drives **carefully**
examples.description: Juft gaplar: sifat otni (qanday?), ravish fe'lni (qanday qilib?) aniqlaydi. O'zbekchada ko'pincha bir so'z, inglizchada — ikki xil shakl.

sentences.text: Aziz is a **careful** driver — he has never had an accident.
sentences.translation: Aziz — **ehtiyotkor** haydovchi, hech qachon avariyaga tushmagan.

sentences.text: Please drive **carefully** — the roads are icy this morning.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **ehtiyot bo'lib** haydang — bugun ertalab yo'llar muz.

sentences.text: We had a **quick** lunch in a café near the office.
sentences.translation: Ofis yaqinidagi kafeda **tezgina** tushlik qildik.

sentences.text: Nilufar **quickly** realised that she had taken the wrong bus.
sentences.translation: Nilufar noto'g'ri avtobusga chiqqanini **tezda** tushundi.

sentences.text: There was **heavy** rain all night, and some streets were flooded.
sentences.translation: Tun bo'yi **kuchli** yomg'ir yog'di, ba'zi ko'chalarni suv bosdi.

sentences.text: It rained **heavily** during the match, but nobody left the stadium.
sentences.translation: O'yin paytida yomg'ir **sharillab** yog'di, lekin hech kim stadiondan ketmadi.

sentences.text: Sarah has a very **soft** voice, so it's hard to hear her in class.
sentences.translation: Saraning ovozi juda **mayin**, shuning uchun darsda uni eshitish qiyin.

sentences.text: The nurse spoke **softly** so as not to wake the other patients.
sentences.translation: Hamshira boshqa bemorlarni uyg'otib yubormaslik uchun **ohista** gapirdi.

sentences.text: Jasur gave a **polite** answer, although he was clearly angry.
sentences.translation: Jasurning jahli chiqqani aniq bo'lsa ham, u **xushmuomala** javob berdi.

sentences.text: Could you ask him **politely** to turn his music down?
sentences.translation: Undan musiqasini pasaytirishni **odob bilan** so'ray olasizmi?

examples.title: Spelling: **easily**, **gently**, **automatically**
examples.description: -ly ning yozilishi: -y → -ily, -le → -ly, -ic → -ically, full → fully, true → truly.

sentences.text: You can **easily** walk from the hotel to the old city.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonadan eski shahargacha **bemalol** piyoda borsa bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Hold the baby **gently** — he's only two weeks old.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloqni **ehtiyotlab** ushlang — u bor-yo'g'i ikki haftalik.

sentences.text: The doors open **automatically** when the train stops.
sentences.translation: Poyezd to'xtaganda eshiklar **avtomatik ravishda** ochiladi.

sentences.text: My grandparents have been **happily** married for fifty years.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvim ellik yildan beri **baxtli** turmush kechirishadi.

sentences.text: I'm **truly** grateful for everything you've done for my family.
sentences.translation: Oilam uchun qilgan barcha yaxshiliklaringiz uchun **chin dildan** minnatdorman.

sentences.text: Bekzod **angrily** threw his phone onto the sofa.
sentences.translation: Bekzod telefonini **jahl bilan** divanga otib yubordi.

sentences.text: The hotel was **fully** booked, so we had to find another one.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona **to'liq** band ekan, shuning uchun boshqasini qidirishga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Prices have risen **dramatically** since the beginning of the year.
sentences.translation: Yil boshidan beri narxlar **keskin** oshdi.

sentences.text: We'll **probably** be late, so don't wait for us.
sentences.translation: **Ehtimol**, kechikamiz, shuning uchun bizni kutmang.

sentences.text: The instructions were written **simply** and **clearly**, so anyone could follow them.
sentences.translation: Yo'riqnoma **sodda** va **tushunarli** yozilgan edi, shuning uchun uni har kim tushuna olardi.

examples.title: Adverb + adjective: **terribly sorry**, **reasonably cheap**
examples.description: Ravish sifatdan oldin kelib, uning darajasini ko'rsatadi: unusually warm, completely different, seriously ill.

sentences.text: I'm **terribly sorry** — I didn't mean to step on your foot.
sentences.translation: **Juda uzr** — oyog'ingizni ataylab bosmadim.

sentences.text: Flats in this area are **reasonably cheap** for students.
sentences.translation: Bu hududdagi kvartiralar talabalar uchun **nisbatan arzon**.

sentences.text: It's **unusually warm** for November — it feels like spring.
sentences.translation: Noyabr uchun havo **g'ayrioddiy iliq** — xuddi bahorga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: My new job is **completely different** from my old one.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishim eskisidan **butunlay boshqacha**.

sentences.text: Grandpa is **seriously ill**, so the whole family has come to visit him.
sentences.translation: Bobom **og'ir kasal**, shuning uchun butun oila uni ko'rgani keldi.

sentences.text: The exam was **surprisingly easy**, so I finished in half an hour.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **kutilmaganda oson** ekan, shuning uchun yarim soatda tugatdim.

sentences.text: You're **absolutely right** — we should have booked the tickets earlier.
sentences.translation: **Mutlaqo haqsiz** — chiptalarni oldinroq band qilishimiz kerak edi.

sentences.text: Their new baby is **amazingly calm** and almost never cries.
sentences.translation: Ularning chaqalog'i **hayratlanarli darajada xotirjam**, deyarli yig'lamaydi.

sentences.text: Are you **perfectly sure** that you locked the front door?
sentences.translation: Eshikni qulflaganingizga **mutlaqo aminmisiz**?

sentences.text: The meeting was **extremely useful**, and we agreed on almost everything.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **nihoyatda foydali** bo'ldi, deyarli hamma narsada kelishib oldik.

examples.title: Adverb + past participle: **badly damaged**, **seriously injured**
examples.description: Ravish fe'lning uchinchi shakli (V3) bilan: badly damaged, highly recommended, newly built — ko'pincha majhul gaplarda.

sentences.text: Several houses were **badly damaged** in the storm.
sentences.translation: Bo'ronda bir nechta uy **qattiq shikastlandi**.

sentences.text: The driver was **seriously injured** and taken to hospital by helicopter.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi **og'ir jarohatlandi** va vertolyotda kasalxonaga olib ketildi.

sentences.text: This restaurant is **highly recommended** by people who live here.
sentences.translation: Bu restoranni mahalliy aholi **juda tavsiya qiladi**.

sentences.text: The conference was **poorly organised**, and nobody knew where to go.
sentences.translation: Konferensiya **yomon tashkil qilingan** edi — hech kim qayerga borishni bilmasdi.

sentences.text: We live in a **newly built** block of flats on the edge of the city.
sentences.translation: Shahar chekkasidagi **yangi qurilgan** ko'p qavatli uyda yashaymiz.

sentences.text: Last year the new law was **heavily criticised** by teachers and parents.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili yangi qonun o'qituvchilar va ota-onalar tomonidan **qattiq tanqid qilindi**.

sentences.text: The village is **easily reached** by bus from Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Qishloqqa Samarqanddan avtobusda **oson yetib borsa bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Her first novel was **warmly received** by critics.
sentences.translation: Uning ilk romanini tanqidchilar **iliq kutib olishdi**.

sentences.text: Madina's report was **beautifully written**, but it was far too long.
sentences.translation: Madinaning hisoboti **chiroyli yozilgan** edi, lekin haddan tashqari uzun edi.

sentences.text: Local craftsmen have **carefully restored** the old mosque.
sentences.translation: Mahalliy ustalar eski masjidni **sinchkovlik bilan ta'mirlashdi**.

examples.title: **looked angry** or **looked** at me **angrily**?
examples.description: Holat fe'li (look, smell, feel, taste, seem) + sifat — qanday ekan; o'sha fe'l harakat bo'lsa + ravish — qanday qildi.

sentences.text: Kate **looked angry** when I told her the news.
sentences.translation: Unga yangilikni aytganimda Keytning **jahli chiqqani ko'rinib turardi**.

sentences.text: Kate **looked** at me **angrily** and left the room without a word.
sentences.translation: Keyt menga **jahl bilan qaradi** va indamay xonadan chiqib ketdi.

sentences.text: The fish **smelled** a bit **strange**, so we didn't eat it.
sentences.translation: Baliqning **hidi** biroz **g'alati** edi, shuning uchun uni yemadik.

sentences.text: The dog **smelled** my bag **suspiciously** for a long time.
sentences.translation: It sumkamni uzoq vaqt **shubha bilan hidlab ko'rdi**.

sentences.text: Your idea **sounds** really **interesting** — tell me more.
sentences.translation: G'oyangiz juda **qiziqqa o'xshaydi** — batafsilroq aytib bering.

sentences.text: I **feel** really **bad** about forgetting your birthday.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningni unutganimdan **o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman**.

sentences.text: The doctor **felt** my arm **carefully** to check if it was broken.
sentences.translation: Shifokor qo'lim singanmi-yo'qmi bilish uchun uni **ehtiyotlab ushlab ko'rdi**.

sentences.text: Everybody **seemed happy** with the decision.
sentences.translation: Qarordan hamma **mamnun ko'rindi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **tasted** the sauce **nervously** — he had never cooked for guests before.
sentences.translation: Bekzod sousni **hayajon bilan tatib ko'rdi** — u ilgari hech qachon mehmonlar uchun ovqat pishirmagan edi.

sentences.text: In the end the sauce **tasted perfect**, and the guests asked for more.
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat sousning **ta'mi juda zo'r chiqdi** va mehmonlar yana so'rashdi.

examples.title: **-ly** adjectives: **friendly**, **lonely** → **in a friendly way**
examples.description: friendly, lovely, lonely, elderly, silly, likely — sifat, ulardan ravish yasalmaydi: in a friendly way. daily, weekly — ham sifat, ham ravish.

sentences.text: The staff at the hotel were really **friendly** and helpful.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xodimlari juda **samimiy** va yordamga tayyor edi.

sentences.text: The receptionist smiled at us **in a friendly way** and gave us the keys.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimi bizga **samimiylik bilan** jilmaydi va kalitlarni berdi.

sentences.text: After his wife died, the old man felt very **lonely**.
sentences.translation: Xotini vafot etgach, keksa odam o'zini juda **yolg'iz** his qildi.

sentences.text: We had a **lovely** time at your parents' house — thank you!
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiznikida **ajoyib** vaqt o'tkazdik — rahmat!

sentences.text: There are many **elderly** people living alone in our neighbourhood.
sentences.translation: Mahallamizda yolg'iz yashaydigan **keksa** odamlar ko'p.

sentences.text: Don't be **silly** — of course you can come with us!
sentences.translation: **Bema'ni gapirma** — albatta biz bilan borsang bo'ladi!

sentences.text: It's **likely** to rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
sentences.translation: Tushdan keyin yomg'ir yog'ish **ehtimoli katta**, soyabon olib ol.

sentences.text: The teacher explained the rules **in a lively way**, and the kids loved it.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi qoidalarni **jonli qilib** tushuntirdi, bolalarga bu juda yoqdi.

sentences.text: Is this a **daily** flight, or does it only fly at weekends?
sentences.translation: Bu **har kungi** reysmi yoki faqat dam olish kunlari uchadimi?

sentences.text: Our local newspaper comes out **weekly**, every Friday morning.
sentences.translation: Mahalliy gazetamiz **haftada bir marta**, har juma kuni ertalab chiqadi.

examples.title: Adjective or adverb? Both in one sentence
examples.description: Bir gapda ham sifat, ham ravish: har birini o'z joyida tanib olish — kim / nima qanday, harakat qanday bajarildi.

sentences.text: The test was **easy**, and Dilnoza passed it **easily**.
sentences.translation: Test **oson** edi va Dilnoza undan **osongina** o'tdi.

sentences.text: Oliver speaks Spanish **fluently** — his grammar is almost **perfect**.
sentences.translation: Oliver ispanchada **ravon** gapiradi — grammatikasi deyarli **mukammal**.

sentences.text: The weather was **awful**, but we enjoyed the trip **enormously**.
sentences.translation: Havo **dahshatli** edi, lekin sayohatdan **behad** zavqlandik.

sentences.text: I'm **sure** she'll pass — she's been studying **seriously** for months.
sentences.translation: U o'tishiga **aminman** — oylardan beri **jiddiy** o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: Please be **quiet** — your father is sleeping and you're talking too **loudly**.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **jim** bo'linglar — dadang uxlayapti, sizlar esa juda **baland** gapiryapsizlar.

sentences.text: Tom made a **terrible** mistake and **immediately** apologised to the client.
sentences.translation: Tom **dahshatli** xato qildi va mijozdan **darhol** uzr so'radi.

sentences.text: Our new manager is **strict**, but she treats everyone **fairly**.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejerimiz **talabchan**, lekin hammaga **adolatli** munosabatda bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Jasur was **nervous** before the match, but he played **brilliantly**.
sentences.translation: Jasur o'yin oldidan **hayajonda** edi, lekin **ajoyib** o'ynadi.

sentences.text: It was a **long** journey, so the children **gradually** fell asleep in the back.
sentences.translation: Yo'l **uzoq** edi, shuning uchun bolalar orqa o'rindiqda **asta-sekin** uxlab qolishdi.

sentences.text: Your English is **excellent** — you write **clearly** and **correctly**.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz **a'lo** — **aniq** va **to'g'ri** yozasiz.

examples.title: Mixed: work, news and daily life
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: sifat yoki ravish, ravish + sifat, ravish + V3 va butun gapga baho beruvchi ravish.

sentences.text: Last year the company's profits fell **sharply**, and several offices closed.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili kompaniya foydasi **keskin** tushib ketdi va bir nechta ofis yopildi.

sentences.text: The new metro line is **surprisingly quiet** and comfortable.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi **kutilmaganda sokin** va qulay.

sentences.text: Emma answered all the interview questions **confidently**.
sentences.translation: Emma suhbatdagi barcha savollarga **ishonch bilan** javob berdi.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the museum is **temporarily** closed for repairs.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, muzey ta'mir uchun **vaqtincha** yopiq.

sentences.text: My grandmother still walks to the market **slowly** but **steadily** every morning.
sentences.translation: Buvim hali ham har tong bozorga **sekin**, lekin **dadil** yurib boradi.

sentences.text: Aziz felt **awful** after eating too much at the wedding.
sentences.translation: Aziz to'yda ko'p yeb qo'yib, o'zini **juda yomon** his qildi.

sentences.text: The situation is **extremely serious**, and we need to act **quickly**.
sentences.translation: Vaziyat **nihoyatda jiddiy**, **tezda** harakat qilishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: She smiled **politely**, but it was **obvious** that she was bored.
sentences.translation: U **xushmuomalalik bilan** jilmaydi, lekin zerikkani **aniq** ko'rinib turardi.

sentences.text: Is it **really** necessary to print all these documents?
sentences.translation: Bu hujjatlarning hammasini chop etish **rostdan ham** shartmi?

sentences.text: Prices here are **reasonable**, and the food is **wonderfully** fresh.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda narxlar **maqbul**, ovqat esa **ajoyib darajada** yangi.
